Safetensors stores tensor metadata and contiguous byte ranges without arbitrary Python object deserialization. Memory mapping allows access to file-backed regions and can avoid eager copies or loading unused tensors; actual device transfer still must move bytes into GPU memory. This removes pickle's arbitrary-code execution mechanism from the tensor format. [1](https://huggingface.co/docs/safetensors/index)

A tenfold speedup is workload-specific, depending on storage, page cache, sharding, access patterns, and the loading path. Modern `torch.load` also offers options such as restricted weight loading and memory mapping, so compare explicit configurations. A safe tensor format does not make model outputs trustworthy or eliminate all parser, resource-exhaustion, or repository-code risks. Verify artifact integrity, shapes, and provenance and benchmark cold and warm loads separately rather than reporting cached-file timing as disk throughput.
